runtime: Offline JavaScript, float32 arrays and Web Workers; no external libraries

architecture.attention: Two independent global queries (44 -> 96), tanh, scaled dot-product softmax over opponent embeddings
architecture.actionSelection: BANK preference >=0.5, except exact rule overrides; action values are auxiliary only

exactFeatures.targetRecurrence: h(p) = [6*h(2p) + sum(count[s]*h(p+s))]/36, h(p>=target)=1; bust contribution is zero
exactFeatures.largerTargets: Integer grid lower/upper bounds, approximately 512 cells
exactFeatures.scoreArithmetic: Safe integer Number, then BigInt promotion
ruleOverrides: Two-player strict-lead preservation by public bank matching
Final-round strict-lead shadowing with one active rival

training.algorithm: Synchronous data-parallel PPO actor-critic with terminal-value and chosen-action-value auxiliary losses
training.reward: Terminal first place 1; k-way first-place tie 1/k; otherwise 0
training.valueTargets: Bounded terminal win shares; GAE advantages normalize within each table size over non-forced decisions
training.valueLoss: 0.5 * binary cross entropy; chosen-action auxiliary loss 0.2 * binary cross entropy
training.earlyStop: Sampled PPO KL >0.025 before steps; full-batch Bernoulli KL after epochs stops at 0.01 and restores epoch weights plus optimizer above 0.025
training.warmStart: Until both 8192 unique collected positions and 8 updates; imitate threshold heuristic plus 5% random branch; no full v3.5 search teacher
training.selfPlay: 30% all-current lineups; remaining games mix current policies, scripts and protected/historical snapshots. Rival selection uses smoothed per-table relative win-share difficulty with a nonzero coverage floor.
training.syntheticStates: Random round and score scale 10^2 to 10^8; half of synthetic games also randomize pot and active players
training.parallelism: 1/2/4/6 workers independently selectable; all generate frozen-policy games, then all compute gradients at identical weights. Raw gradient sums merge weighted by sample count; worker 0 applies one synchronized Adam step. No six separate models or stale-policy updates.
training.storageKey: current-banknet-2; original current key for Bank Net 1 is retained
training.checkpoint: Latest and protected-best weights and matching optimizers, league, settings, last detailed benchmark, resumable benchmark blocks and 120 compact history entries in the existing IndexedDB slot

pairedFeedback.sampling: Uniform reservoir over collected non-forced current-policy decision positions; disabled during warm-up
pairedFeedback.evaluation: Both first actions roll to terminal results using frozen lineup policies, identical future dice addressing and common opponent noise; paired worlds use a marginal-preserving 18-face antithetic shift
pairedFeedback.targets: Both action-value heads receive empirical win-share targets; clipped, shrunken expected-action policy gradient supplements PPO
pairedFeedback.episodeCounter: Counts collected full games only; branch continuations tracked separately

evaluation.cells: Selected table sizes x 10/15/20 rounds; original fixed scripted opponent suite
evaluation.reference: Threshold heuristic, not full v3.5 engine
evaluation.comparison: Original v4.6 scripted opponent sampling, dice, seat rotation and opponent-noise addressing are unchanged. Candidate and protected best use matched fixtures with a separate heuristic reference. Fresh confirmation gates promotion or regression recovery. Neural rivals are used in training only.

status: Experimental and initially untrained. Capacity, mathematical and runtime tests do not establish superiority over v3.5.

trainerStability.promotion: paired 95% positive delta on fixed and independent fresh fixtures
trainerStability.regression: paired 95% upper delta below -0.02 on both suites restores best weights and optimizer
